## Current Role
Senior Software Infrastructure Engineer / Technical Lead at **Apple Inc.** (Sunnyvale, CA — May 2019 – Present). Architecting infrastructure for a 30+ engineer manufacturing organization. Areas: ML platform automating model deployment to factories, MSI Cloud Engineering migration to Snowflake/Kafka/Redis on AWS+Kubernetes, embedded systems conversion from iOS to Go for production-line communication, automated AI code/compliance reviewer with multi-model (Claude, Gemini) PR review and CI/CD policy gating, and an internal AI agent plugin ecosystem for code review, security, release engineering, and multi-agent orchestration.

## Career Highlights
- **Apple** (2019–Present) — Software Architect, manufacturing infrastructure, ML platform, AI initiatives.
- **Roblox** (2018–2019) — Principal Software Engineer, Infrastructure Services. Service reliability + .NET Core migration.
- **eBay** (2016–2018) — Principal Software Engineer, Data Services. Architected unified data query layer using Apache Calcite over 7+ heterogeneous stores (Elasticsearch, Cassandra, MongoDB, Couchbase) on Kubernetes.
- **WalmartLabs** (2012–2016) — Staff Software Engineer. Smart Sourcing supply-chain optimization engine; Smart Pricing big data infrastructure (Java, Spring, Hibernate, Hive, Cassandra, Solr, LevelDB).
- **Addepar** (2013–2014) — Data + Architecture teams. 10x service performance optimization.
- **Amazon** (2011–2012) — SDE, Search Experience. Visually Similar search, Mason-to-Java migration, mobile search, multi-language CJK search via Lucene.
- **Microsoft** (2008–2011) — SDE II. Office Mobile Shared Services (OneNote on Symbian, C++/RVCT/QML); Mobile Advertising automated test framework.
- **Yahoo!** (2007–2008, intern 2006) — Search Marketing. Ad keyword canonicalization service in C++ at 10,000 QPS across 20+ markets.
